lead: The AI Chat family put together: the conversation list ([Thread List](/thread-list)), starter prompts ([Suggestions](/suggestions)), the message area that sticks to the bottom ([Chat Thread](/chat-thread)), user / assistant messages ([Chat Turn](/chat-turn)) with the reasoning ([Reasoning](/reasoning)), tool calls ([Tool Call](/tool-call)), Markdown replies (with [Code Block](/code-block)), sources ([Citation](/citation)) and attachments ([Attachment](/attachment)), and the input area at the bottom ([Composer](/composer)). The replies are fake: timers simulate the streaming.

full.title: Full chat
full.description: Click a starter prompt or type a message and send it: first Typing, then the shimmering Reasoning and a tool call, and finally the streamed Markdown reply with its sources. While generating, the send button becomes stop, and follow-ups can be queued (Queue); select text in an assistant reply to quote it (Quote). Once the reply is done there is a Plan, a Terminal and a card for the artifact: click the card to open the Artifact on the right (DiffView / WebPreview).
full.answer:
Here is a short plan, based on what I found:

1. **Parse** the input into a typed shape
2. **Validate** every field with a schema
3. Return the result or the list of errors

```ts
const result = schema.safeParse(input);
if (!result.success) return result.error.issues;
```

| Step | Cost |
| :--- | ---: |
| Parse | low |
| Validate | medium |

Skins are plain CSS files[1] and behaviour comes from Base UI[2].
full.alternate1: Short version: parse, validate, report errors.[1]
full.alternate2: You could also validate on blur and show inline errors as the user types.[2]
